scenario: A `call` with an `on response` continuation reading the outer binding's mutable slot `{s.room}` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. LCCO.5.4's snapshot semantics needs a run: the continuation reads the value captured at activation, even after the fact has changed or gone. `compile_ok` observes neither that nor the `$CaptureBindings_<rule>_c<N>` pattern.
rules_ds:
schema SensorReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    reading: Int

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SensorReadReply

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    room: String mutable

rule read_sensor:
    Sensor s
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: s.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
        on response.reading > 0:
            log info "sensor {s.room} responded"
